description: Diagnostic daemon to verify signal_analyser_v2.py correctly reads and applies enrichment scores from the four _enrichment modules. Queries mcp_signal_enrichments table for count per signal_type (permission_scope, temporal_stability, tool_description_safety, supply_chain_enrichment, community_signal_enrichment). Reports coverage percentage vs mcp_server_registry (10134 rows). Writes findings to service_health meta field. Does NOT fix signal_analyser_v2.py directly (protected). Reports gap via console log and returns non-zero exit if any enrichment has <5% coverage. Run on schedule every 6h.
